# Where the test fixtures come from

The code in this repository is AGPL-3.0-or-later. The text fixtures below are quoted material
with their own provenance, kept here solely as test data.

| File | Source | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `texts/il-declaration-1948.he.md` | he.wikisource.org, מגילת העצמאות של מדינת ישראל | Official Israeli state document. Exempt from copyright under section 6 of Israel's Copyright Act. |
| `corpus/il-declaration.he.md` | Same, refetched with the site apparatus trimmed | Same. |
| `corpus/il-declaration.en.md` | en.wikisource.org, Declaration of Independence (Israel) | Official English translation published by the State of Israel. Same exemption. |
| `corpus/us-declaration.en.md` | en.wikisource.org, United States Declaration of Independence (engrossed copy) | 1776, public domain. |
| `corpus/us-declaration.he.md` | he.wikisource.org, הכרזת העצמאות של ארצות הברית | Hebrew translation hosted on Wikisource. Treat as CC BY-SA per Wikisource terms; attribution: Hebrew Wikisource contributors. |
| `wikisource/novelle-rusticane.json`, `wikisource/cenere.json` | it.wikisource.org API `action=parse` answers for Verga, *Novelle rusticane* (1883), and Deledda, *Cenere* (1904), recorded 2026-09-14 and trimmed to two chapters of one or two paragraphs, styles and images removed | Public domain (Verga d. 1922, Deledda d. 1936). Transcriptions CC BY-SA per Wikisource terms; attribution: Italian Wikisource contributors. |
| `wikisource/il-declaration.he.json` | he.wikisource.org API `action=parse` answer for מגילת העצמאות של מדינת ישראל, recorded 2026-09-14, styles and images removed | As `texts/il-declaration-1948.he.md`. |
| `texts/reading-old-books.epub` | Generated by this project's test tooling | AGPL-3.0-or-later, part of this repository. |
| `corpus/*.gold.json` | Hand-checked alignment links written for this project | AGPL-3.0-or-later, part of this repository. |
| `storyweaver/7686.it.json` | storyweaver.org.in API, story 7686, *La luna e il cappello*, pictures and scripts trimmed | CC BY 4.0. Translated by Silvia Lucchin (© 2016), from *La lune et la casquette* by Annie Marois (© 2015), based on *The Moon and The Cap* by Rohini Nilekani (© Pratham Books, 2007); illustrations by Angie & Upesh (© Pratham Books). Via StoryWeaver. |
| `storyweaver/1124.fr.json` | Same API, story 1124, *La lune et la casquette*, trimmed the same way | CC BY 4.0. Translated by Annie Marois (© 2015), from the same original. |
| `storyweaver/234.en.json` | Same API, story 234, *The Moon and The Cap*, trimmed the same way | CC BY 4.0. Written by Rohini Nilekani, © Pratham Books, 2007; illustrations by Angie & Upesh. |

Nothing else in `tests/fixtures/` is quoted from elsewhere. The tool itself never
bundles or ships the texts a user reads; these files exist so the aligner can be
scored against real translation pairs offline.
